{{Infobox auto|type=Explosive|renewable=Yes}}
A '''bedrock buster''' is a special charge of [[TNT]] that destroys {{MCW|Bedrock|bedrock}}. Placed on a block, it becomes a glowing primed TNT, and just before it explodes it clears a 3×7×3 column of bedrock around itself, letting players break through the floor of the Overworld or the roof and floor of [[Hell]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Each bedrock buster costs a {{ItemLink|Divine Fragment}}, the pack's scarcest progression material.

== Usage ==
The bedrock buster is a spawn egg that holds a primed TNT entity.<ref name="item">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bedrock_buster.json}}</ref> Using it on a block:
# spawns a primed, glowing TNT with an 80-tick (4-second) fuse and explosion power 4;
# 79 ticks later, removes every bedrock block in a 3×7×3 area centered on the nearest glowing TNT (1 block to each side horizontally, 3 blocks up and down) and releases a burst of end rod particles;<ref name="use">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/bedrock_buster_use.mcfunction}}</ref>
# the TNT then explodes normally one tick later, damaging the surrounding blocks and entities.

The bedrock removal is triggered by an advancement when the buster is used on a block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/bedrock_buster.mcfunction}}</ref> Only the bedrock around one glowing TNT is removed per activation: if several busters are used within 79 ticks, the scheduled removal is replaced and only runs once, at the glowing TNT nearest to the world spawn point.

=== Spawners ===
{{Main|Spawner#Spawn eggs}}
Because it is a spawn egg, using a bedrock buster on a spawner counts as putting a spawn egg on it: every spawner within 16 blocks is destroyed and the player takes 20 damage.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/no_eggs_on_spawners.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The item is a chicken spawn egg with a custom model.
* In the design video, bedrock busters are listed among the items that need a divine fragment, as part of the reasoning against building mob farms: "If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment.}}</ref>
